title: 021 来自星星的诅咒022 列星降戾二合一
content_zh:
张泱主动忽略系统日志的提醒。
什么慎重招募？
根本用不着慎重！
无脑招募，不用迟疑！
对张泱而言，即便神秘血人忠诚、道德、野心三项全是满分，带给她的吸引力都不如三项为零分的吸引力大。用观察样本的话来说，考试全部拿零分跟全部满分一样有难度，一样稀罕。如此稀罕的，她高低要尝尝咸淡！
尽管张泱没什么表情，但谢恕并未错过她瞳孔细微的变化：“小友对他感兴趣？”
张泱压抑着兴奋：“他太有意思了。”
谢恕平静垂下了眼睑，视线隐晦扫过昏迷中的血人，跟着又发出一声意味不明的喟叹：“小友喜欢就好，或许也是他的福缘。”
张泱戳了戳血人的脸颊。
盯着对方头顶上看似岌岌可危的血条：“哪里有医院？我带他去看看，止个血。”
“人已经在院外等着了。”
谢恕早早让人去请医术最好的医者过来。
待医者将神秘血人衣衫褪去，沈知倒吸一口凉气：“……这些伤口，看着古怪。愈合结痂的旧伤一看就是受刑留下的鞭伤，但这些新伤看着……我一时分不出个究竟。”
有些伤口看着像是被人用手指抠开撕裂的，有些伤口像是被尖锐钝器反复割开的。
不止前胸，双臂双腿都有。
囚衣裹着的身体几乎没几块好肉。
沈知很快注意到谢恕看着昏迷血人都有些隐晦动容，反观张泱情绪却出奇平静。既没有被血肉模糊吓出来的畏惧，也没有看到惨状生出的同情，似乎躺着的是一个器具。
沈知拱手：“冒昧一问，这些伤口是何人所留？杀人不过头点地，何必施酷刑？”
这得多恨对方才想得出这些损招？
“除了鞭痕，其余是他自己弄的。”

张泱的注意力一下子被谢恕勾引过来。
“他自己弄的？他干嘛自残？”
不愧是能拿三项零分的人，居然还有自毁自残倾向，估计精神状态也非常有意思。
“女君的意思是他是……”沈知没在第一时间反应过来，直到灵光一闪，一个猜测悄然浮现脑海，情绪也顺势切换成同情、唏嘘。
张泱：“你知道他怎么回事？”
“……隐约猜到一点点，但不知是不是对的。”沈知也不知从何开始解释，毕竟张泱连一些基础常识都没有，“我此前跟你说过，失去各自星官的星辰所属非要逆天改命也不是没有机会，只是代价甚大……他变成这个模样，估计是跟所谓‘代价’有关。”
“这个‘代价’不是一次就能清算的。”
“它是伴随终生、如影随形的诅咒。要是倒霉些，一辈子可能要背负不止一个。”
张泱听得云里雾里。
不太懂，但她会抓重点。
“背负不止一个是什么意思？”
沈知叹气：“天下势力波诡云谲，谁也不知道昨儿还在的政权，明儿是不是就被人推翻了。人间王朝之争，便是星君之争，败者万劫不复。倘若我今日非要逆天改命，付出一回代价投了这个星君阵营麾下，明儿这位星君倒下了，我还要逆天改命呢？那只能再付出一回代价投靠下一位。改换门庭一次便要背负一次‘诅咒’，所以不止一个。”
不幸中的万幸——
大多数“诅咒”都是在最开始的“诅咒”上面加重加深，而不是凭空又冒出一个。
content_en:
Zhang Yang took the initiative to ignore the system log reminder.
What careful recruitment?
No need to be cautious at all!
Brainless recruitment, no need to hesitate!
For Zhang Yang, even if the mysterious blood man scored full marks on loyalty, morality, and ambition, the appeal he brought to her would not be as great as if he had zero marks on all three items. In terms of observation samples, getting all zeros on the exam is just as difficult and as rare as getting all the perfect scores. It's so rare, she wants to taste it!
Although Zhang Yang had no expression, Xie Shu did not miss the subtle changes in her pupils: "Little friend, are you interested in him?"
Zhang Yang suppressed his excitement: "He is so interesting."
Xie Shu calmly lowered his eyelids, his eyes vaguely swept over the unconscious bloody man, and then he let out an unknown sigh: "It's good that my little friend likes him, maybe it's his blessing."
Zhang Yang poked the bloody man's cheek.
Staring at the seemingly dangerous blood bar above the other person's head: "Where is the hospital? I'll take him to see him and stop the bleeding."
"People are already waiting outside the hospital."
Thank you for sending someone to invite the best doctor over early.
The doctor who was waiting for the doctor took off the mysterious blood man's clothes, and Shen Zhi took a breath of cold air: "...these wounds look weird. The old wounds that have healed and scabbed are whip wounds caused by torture, but these new wounds look like...I can't tell for a moment."
Some of the wounds looked like they had been picked and torn with fingers, and some looked like they had been cut repeatedly with a sharp blunt instrument.
Not only the chest, but also both arms and legs.
The body wrapped in prison clothes had almost no good flesh.
Shen Zhi quickly noticed that Xie Shu looked vaguely moved when he saw the unconscious bloody man, but Zhang Yang's mood was surprisingly calm. There was neither fear from being frightened by the bloody flesh nor sympathy from seeing the tragic situation. It seemed that what was lying there was a tool.
Shen Zhi held up his hands: "I would like to ask, who inflicted these wounds? If you can't kill someone with a nod, why torture?"
How much do you have to hate the other party to think of these damaging moves?
"Except for the whip marks, he did it himself."
Zhang Yang's attention was suddenly attracted by Xie Shu.
"Did he do it himself? Why did he hurt himself?"
As expected of a person who can score three zero points, he actually has a tendency to self-destruct and harm himself. His mental state is probably very interesting.
"Nvjun means that he is..." Shen Zhi did not react at the first moment, until a flash of inspiration came to his mind, and a guess quietly emerged in his mind, and his emotions switched to sympathy and sigh.
Zhang Yang: "Do you know what happened to him?"
"... I vaguely guessed a little bit, but I don't know if it's right." Shen Zhi didn't know where to start explaining. After all, Zhang Yang didn't even have some basic common sense. "I told you before that if you lose the star affiliation of your respective star officer, you have to change your fate against the will of heaven. It's not impossible, but the cost is very high... His becoming like this is probably related to the so-called 'cost'."
"This 'price' cannot be settled in one go."
"It is a curse that follows you throughout your life. If you are unlucky, you may have to bear more than one in your life."
Zhang Yang was confused when he heard this.
I don’t really understand, but she will grasp the key points.
"What does it mean to carry more than one?"
Shen Zhi sighed: "The forces in the world are in turmoil. No one knows whether the regime that was still there yesterday will be overthrown tomorrow. The battle between dynasties in the world is the battle between star kings, and the loser will never recover. If I have to change my destiny today, I will pay the price. I paid the price once to join this star king's camp. If this star king falls tomorrow, will I have to change my fate? Then I can only pay the price again to join the next one. I have to bear the 'curse' once, so there is more than one."
Fortunately among misfortunes——
Most "curses" are aggravation and deepening of the original "curse", rather than another one appearing out of thin air.
